agent_notes.text: Self-hosting canopy.json created (TODO 5h). Agent-scored — all scores need human review. Relation graph covers CLI→schema, routes→canopy.ts, and docs→docs links. Run `canopytag health` to see what needs attention.
Current public docs are README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/cli-cheatsheet.md, and docs/roadmap.md. Compare/MCP/docs are now wired; use canopytag compare when deciding trust order between exact files.

package.json.title: Package And Development Contract
package.json.summary: Declares the private prerelease package, CLI binary, local development/build/test commands, and runtime dependencies that make the source checkout usable.

bin/canopytag.mjs.title: CanopyTag CLI Dispatcher
bin/canopytag.mjs.summary: Cross-platform Node entrypoint that maps public command names to TypeScript handlers and forwards arguments through the local tsx runtime without shell interpolation.

src/shared/types.ts.title: Canopy Schema & Authority Health
src/shared/types.ts.summary: Single source of truth for shared and local types including file annotations, authored production scopes, project-only rich Task subtypes with dependencies/resources/milestones/receipts, project HTTP projections, trust, lifecycle, relationships, analytics, review, and active-work claims. All CLI, API, UI, and MCP surfaces import from here; disk keys are snake_case while TypeScript fields are camelCase.

comments.text: checkAuthorityHealth only flags promotion-candidate if authorityLevel !== 'standard'. This means a standard-level file can never be flagged as overscored, which is probably correct but worth stating explicitly — standards are the ceiling.

src/shared/project-tasks.ts.title: Pure Project Task Readiness Projection
src/shared/project-tasks.ts.summary: Computes ready, blocked, claimed, in-progress, done, and deferred project task states from authored status, directed blocking edges, required decisions, dependency cycles, and optional live active-work path claims. It never persists derived readiness and exposes deterministic counts plus cycle discovery for CLI, API, UI, MCP, and doctor reuse.

src/shared/project-tasks.test.ts.title: Project Task Readiness Contracts
src/shared/project-tasks.test.ts.summary: Protects depends_on and blocks direction, non-blocking relational edges, required-decision blockers, active-claim derivation without persisted state, invalid references, cycle detection, and deterministic ready/blocked/claimed counts.

src/shared/case-transform.ts.title: Snake/Case Metadata Boundary
src/shared/case-transform.ts.summary: Recursively converts committed snake_case schema fields to runtime camelCase and back while preserving authored keys inside files, features, directories, projects, and scope_sets maps. Nested card fields still convert normally, preventing paths or underscore-bearing IDs from being silently rewritten.

src/shared/lifecycle.ts.title: Lifecycle Mark Validator And Interpreter
src/shared/lifecycle.ts.summary: Validates untrusted lifecycle metadata without discarding malformed evidence, derives open, due, expired, and resolved states from an explicit date, and keeps event- or release-bound marks open until external resolution is recorded.

src/shared/catalogue-search.ts.title: Bounded Authored Catalogue Search
src/shared/catalogue-search.ts.summary: Builds a local weighted index over authored paths, titles, summaries, tags, feature context, open TODOs, active lifecycle reasons, and findings. Returns bounded matches with visible evidence while excluding source text and relationship paths.

src/shared/catalogue-search.test.ts.summary: Protects searchable-field inclusion and exclusion, title-over-comment ranking, conservative prefix and typo matching, visible match evidence, lifecycle-date handling, and the hard result ceiling for authored catalogue search.

src/cli/__tests__/query-cli.test.ts.summary: Protects strict query option parsing: unknown flags fail with a clear error, nonzero status, and no misleading all-files output.

src/backend/lib/canopy.ts.title: Canopy Read/Write & Archive Engine
src/backend/lib/canopy.ts.summary: All disk I/O for canopy.json, settings.json, and canopy_archive.json. Validates required top-level maps including projects and scope_sets, handles snake↔camel transformation, allocates IDs, and runs archive sweeps. Every route that mutates canonical annotations calls through here.

todos.text: runArchiveSweep iterates all files on every TODO mutation. Fine for small repos but O(files × todos) on each write. Consider lazy sweep (sweep on read, or on interval).

Validate known nested Canopy fields, enum values, ranges, feature references, and relation shapes before shared writes at the canonical boundary while preserving tolerant evidence-producing reads and forward-compatible unknown fields; prove equivalent enforcement for route and MCP writes.

src/backend/lib/scope-proposals.ts.title: Generated Scope Membership Proposal Boundary
src/backend/lib/scope-proposals.ts.summary: Reads and validates the optional generated scope-membership sidecar. It requires provider identity, artifact fingerprint, generation and freshness dates, safe repository-relative subjects, known kinds and roles, and exposes deterministic fresh/stale labeling without mutating authored scope sets.

src/backend/lib/agent-manifest.ts.title: Agent Review Manifest And Undo Engine
src/backend/lib/agent-manifest.ts.summary: Persists the agent activity/review feed, normalizes legacy statuses, assigns manifest IDs, and applies agree, fix, or reject decisions for file- or project-scoped writes. Project rejection restores recorded fields only when later changes do not conflict; suggestions remain unapplied.

src/backend/lib/merge.ts.title: Authored And Generated Metadata Projection
src/backend/lib/merge.ts.summary: Builds the UI read model by merging optional repo-index enrichment with authored Canopy metadata, with authored values winning shared fields. It normalizes relations, derives TODO and authority-health signals, and resolves project backlinks plus inherited read-only project tasks at render time.

src/backend/lib/profile.ts.title: Local Human Attribution Profile
src/backend/lib/profile.ts.summary: Resolves human attribution from explicit environment values, Git configuration, or OS identity, sanitizes it, and stores the profile in ignored profile.local.json. It also provides the reusable safe-ignore helper for other local CanopyTag sidecars. Local state stays uncommitted while selected author signatures may be copied into shared review attribution.

src/backend/lib/active-work.ts.title: Local Expiring Work-Claim Engine
src/backend/lib/active-work.ts.summary: Persists advisory file and directory claims in an ignored sidecar with atomic writes, owned locking, platform-aware overlap detection, exclusive or shared modes, expiry, owner/session checks, TODO links, renewal, release, and bounded seven-day local history. Expired work must be claimed again. It does not enforce Git writes, mutate canonical annotations, or own durable task dependencies.

src/cli/work.ts.title: canopytag work — Advisory Check-In And Check-Out
src/cli/work.ts.summary: Agent-facing CLI for checking path claims, creating expiring exclusive or shared claims, linking a unique CanopyTag TODO, renewing owned work, and releasing with a handoff note. JSON output supports harness integration; conflicts return a distinct exit code and claims never complete TODOs.

src/cli/stats.ts.title: canopytag stats — Orient Before You Dive
src/cli/stats.ts.summary: The first CLI call an agent should make. Reads canopy.json and prints file counts by kind, authority distribution, Canopy-native file/project TODO pressure, matching project count, and a next-step hint. Scoped by --feature or --tag and compact enough for a prompt window.

src/cli/ls.ts.title: canopytag ls — Top N Files by Authority
src/cli/ls.ts.summary: Lightweight summary table: FILE | AUTH | STATUS | FEATURE | TODOS | SUMMARY. Sorts by authority descending, then open TODO count. Default shows top 3 (--limit N or --all). Filtered by --feature or --tag. The step between `stats` (what exists) and `query` (deep dive).

src/cli/query.ts.title: canopytag query — Catalogue Search And Bounded Traversal
src/cli/query.ts.summary: Primary catalogue router combining bounded authored-field search with structured project, feature, tag, kind, trust, date, and relation filters. Project queries include their why, open questions, and project TODOs; detail levels expand the authored relationship graph within explicit hop and closeness bounds.

comments.text: Stability scored 3 because the depth model (numeric 1-5 with named aliases) and self-documenting footer are design bets that haven't been validated with real agent usage yet. The interface works but may evolve after dogfooding.

src/cli/__tests__/query.test.ts.title: Progressive Search And Relation Bounds
src/cli/__tests__/query.test.ts.summary: Protects query presentation, authored-field search integration, filter composition, result limits, and progressive relationship expansion whose hop and relation filters constrain graph noise. Search ranking details are tested in the shared catalogue-search suite.

src/cli/health.ts.title: canopytag health — Authority vs Quality Mismatch Detector
src/cli/health.ts.summary: Surfaces files where declared authority doesn't match quality scores. !! = underscored (spec with low quality — red flag). ^^ = promotion candidate (idea scoring like a guideline). ?? = unscored (has authority but no scores). Uses checkAuthorityHealth() from types.ts. Compact output — 105 lines total.

src/cli/todos.ts.title: canopytag todos — Flat TODO Query
src/cli/todos.ts.summary: Flat aggregate of Canopy-native file- and project-owned TODOs, sorted by priority and labeled with explicit scope kind. Filters include tag, feature, priority, and project. It does not claim to scan Markdown backlogs or inline source markers.

src/cli/projects.ts.title: canopytag projects — Agent Execution Packet
src/cli/projects.ts.summary: Lists active project contexts with computed ready/blocked task counts and renders one project's intent, milestones, typed dependencies, owned paths/exclusions, resources, acceptance criteria, blockers, retained receipts, linked files, and recent activity. Resolution accepts exact IDs/names or one unambiguous substring; projects remain flat and omit board machinery.

src/backend/routes/config.ts.title: Active Repository Switch And Browse API
src/backend/routes/config.ts.summary: Switches the server's active repository, creates its Canopy directory, loads metadata, local identity, optional legacy index and tags, runs archive cleanup, then replaces shared server state. Its folder browser exposes host directory structure to the unauthenticated local API.

src/backend/routes/index.ts.title: Merged Repository Index API
src/backend/routes/index.ts.summary: Returns one record for the union of generated repo-index paths and authored Canopy paths. Each record uses authored-over-generated precedence and includes derived TODO, authority-health, and project-backlink context from the merge projection.

src/backend/routes/manifest.ts.title: Agent Activity Review API
src/backend/routes/manifest.ts.summary: Lists the agent manifest through manifest and activity aliases, then applies agree, fix, or reject decisions using the local human profile for attribution. Reject can invoke recorded undo behavior on already-applied changes.

src/backend/routes/rescan.ts.title: Legacy Repo-Index Reload API
src/backend/routes/rescan.ts.summary: Reloads only the optional docs/_meta/repo_index.json compatibility index into server state. It does not rescan source files, reload Canopy metadata, refresh tags, or rebuild structural maps despite returning a generic rescan-complete message.

src/backend/routes/file.ts.title: File Metadata API
src/backend/routes/file.ts.summary: Primary per-file read and write API. Reads merge authored metadata with optional generated index, Git date, and derived project backlinks/inherited tasks; writes update selected annotation fields and stamp the current local human as reviewer, but authority and status values currently lack runtime enum validation.

comments.text: POST /api/file/meta accepts any string for authorityLevel and status with a bare cast to FileCanopy types. Invalid values (e.g. authorityLevel: 'potato') will be saved to canopy.json and silently break health checks and query sorting.

src/backend/routes/projects.ts.title: Project HTTP List, Detail, And Guarded Update API
src/backend/routes/projects.ts.summary: Exposes project summaries with ready/blocked/claimed task and milestone counts plus full detail packets containing computed task readiness, live claim context, features, every linked path, annotation presence, recent activity, and merged file records. Bounded card updates preserve rich tasks, milestones, and provenance; guarded link replacement rejects stale writes.

src/backend/routes/todo.ts.title: TODO CRUD API
src/backend/routes/todo.ts.summary: POST /api/todo creates (text+priority required) or updates (by id) TODOs. Auto-generates RT-NNN IDs, timestamps createdAt, stamps completedAt when status→done. DELETE by path+todoId. Runs archive sweep after every write. Both create and update paths initialize the file entry and todos array if missing.

src/backend/routes/comment.ts.title: Comment CRUD API
src/backend/routes/comment.ts.summary: POST /api/comment creates comments with auto-generated RC-NNN IDs, optional type (finding/bug/improvement/note), and optional confidence (1-5). DELETE by path+commentId. Runs archive sweep after every write. Structurally parallel to todo.ts but simpler — comments are append-only (no update path).

src/backend/routes/tree.ts.title: File Tree API
src/backend/routes/tree.ts.summary: Read-only recursive filesystem tree for explorer navigation, delegated to the ignore-aware tree walker. It includes unannotated files and is therefore broader than the merged metadata index used by tables and the authored graph.

src/backend/routes/directory.ts.title: Directory Summary API
src/backend/routes/directory.ts.summary: Reads and edits human-authored directory shelf summaries while deriving file and open-TODO counts from annotated descendant paths. Counts therefore describe the current CanopyTag catalogue, not every file discovered by the filesystem tree.

src/backend/routes/features.ts.title: Feature CRUD API
src/backend/routes/features.ts.summary: Reads, upserts, and deletes feature cards. POST keeps basic-card replacement semantics while preserving omitted canonical file, owner, open-question, and promotion fields from richer existing cards; explicit camelCase values persist through the snake_case write boundary.

src/frontend/components/AnalyticsView.ts.title: Local Agent Activity Dashboard
src/frontend/components/AnalyticsView.ts.summary: Human view of local agent activity: hot files, search trends, daily counts, and heat-enabled tree navigation. It duplicates engagement calculations from the backend, so scoring changes must stay aligned; activity frequency is not semantic authority.

src/frontend/components/GraphView.tsx.title: Authored Semantic Relationship Graph
src/frontend/components/GraphView.tsx.summary: Human visualization with overview and file-focus maps plus a bounded Project execution mode. Project mode reads one existing task packet into milestone swimlanes, directed readiness dependencies, selected-task resource/evidence context, and browser-local card positions; it does not persist a second task truth or invent generated structure without provenance.

src/frontend/components/TableView.tsx.title: Files, Scores, TODOs, Projects, And Activity Tables
src/frontend/components/TableView.tsx.summary: Large multi-mode review surface for file inventory, quality scores, globally filterable file/project TODOs, the project lane, and attributed agent activity. Project-owned TODO rows retain a real project scope and open the project detail instead of fabricating a file path.

src/frontend/components/ProjectLane.tsx.title: Project List, Detail, And Safe Card Editor
src/frontend/components/ProjectLane.tsx.summary: Two-pane human project surface with current/status filters, ready/blocked/claimed counts, milestones, bounded task cards, and expandable dependency/resource/evidence packets beside linked feature/file context and recent activity. It preserves unannotated paths, confirms relationship removal, guards stale list replacement, and leaves task lifecycle read-only.

src/frontend/components/FileTree.tsx.title: Explorer File Tree And Activity Heat
src/frontend/components/FileTree.tsx.summary: Explorer navigation over discovered files and directories, enriched with TODO badges and optional seven-day activity heat. Search here filters the visible tree by path or name; it is not semantic or fuzzy catalogue retrieval.

src/frontend/components/Settings.tsx.title: Local Identity And Settings Panel
src/frontend/components/Settings.tsx.summary: Combines browser-local display preferences with repository-local archive and analytics settings plus an ignored local author profile. The profile file remains local, while its chosen author signature is intentionally recorded on shared edits and reviews.

src/frontend/components/WelcomeScreen.ts.title: Repository Picker And Demo Entry
src/frontend/components/WelcomeScreen.ts.summary: Repository connection and bundled-demo entry surface. It can browse local directories and instruct the backend to switch repository roots, so its convenience depends on the unauthenticated backend remaining loopback-only unless explicitly exposed.

src/frontend/lib/api.ts.title: Frontend Local API Facade
src/frontend/lib/api.ts.summary: Typed frontend facade over the local Fastify API for repository switching, merged records, annotations, TODOs, comments, features, project list/detail/guarded updates, settings, analytics, profiles, and activity review. It centralizes transport but performs little runtime response validation.

src/frontend/lib/authority.ts.title: Authority Display Vocabulary
src/frontend/lib/authority.ts.summary: Canonical UI copy and display mapping for the five-level authority hierarchy. It keeps compact labels and explanatory text consistent across score and table views; authority means conflict precedence, not a substitute for quality or freshness.

src/frontend/App.tsx.title: Root Layout & View Router
src/frontend/App.tsx.summary: Top-level connected-state and view router. It gates the repository picker, then coordinates explorer, table, authored graph, analytics, settings, demo guidance, save or error notices, and the agent-note banner.

src/frontend/components/FileDetail.tsx.title: File Annotation Editor
src/frontend/components/FileDetail.tsx.summary: Primary per-file human editor for title, summary, tags, I/O notes, authored relationships, trust scores, TODOs, comments, and derived project backlinks with inherited read-only tasks. Mutations round-trip through the local API and refresh the merged record; it does not display or edit source code.

todos.text: No optimistic UI — every edit round-trips to the server and refreshes the full file record. Feels fine locally but would lag on remote backends.

src/frontend/components/ScoreDisplay.tsx.title: Quality Scores & Authority Level UI
src/frontend/components/ScoreDisplay.tsx.summary: Human editor for four quality dimensions, authority, reviewed state, and review-versus-Git dates. It uses local profile attribution stamped by the file route; marking scores reviewed is a deliberate trust action, not proof of runtime validity.

src/frontend/stores/workspace.ts.title: Global UI State (Zustand)
src/frontend/stores/workspace.ts.summary: Single Zustand coordination store for repository connection, tree and index, file/project selection, projects, features and tags, agent notes, analytics, profile, view mode, and save or error state. Initial load treats analytics as optional; project backlinks can open the Table project lane directly.

comments.text: State shape is growing — 14 state fields plus 10 actions in a single store. Not a problem yet, but if features (like multi-tab or undo) get added, consider splitting into slices.

src/backend/__tests__/canopy.test.ts.title: Canopy Persistence Boundary Contracts
src/backend/__tests__/canopy.test.ts.summary: Protects BOM-tolerant reads, top-level map rejection/defaults including scope_sets, snake_case writes, project and authored-scope round trips, lifecycle evidence preservation, atomic-write cleanup, and monotonic identifiers across the canonical metadata store.

src/backend/__tests__/scope-proposals.te.title: Generated Scope Proposal Provenance Contracts
src/backend/__tests__/scope-proposals.te.summary: Protects optional sidecar discovery, snake/camel parsing, required provider and fingerprint provenance, bounded freshness dates, safe subject paths, supported kinds, and deterministic fresh/stale labels.

src/backend/__tests__/case-transform.tes.title: Metadata Case-Conversion Invariants
src/backend/__tests__/case-transform.tes.summary: Prevents recursive snake/camel conversion from rewriting file paths, underscore feature IDs, project IDs, or authored scope IDs while confirming fields inside their cards and ordinary nested arrays transform normally.

src/backend/__tests__/merge.test.ts.title: Authored-Over-Generated Merge Precedence
src/backend/__tests__/merge.test.ts.summary: Locks the read-model rule that authored Canopy values override shared repo-index fields while generated enrichment remains available as fallback. It also protects lifecycle propagation and derived open-TODO and highest-priority signals.

src/backend/__tests__/agent-manifest.tes.title: Manifest Review And Undo Contracts
src/backend/__tests__/agent-manifest.tes.summary: Protects the human review loop for agent activity: BOM-safe reads, rejection restoring prior annotations, fix decisions adding attributed improvement comments, and agreement changing review state without replaying the original write.

src/backend/__tests__/profile.test.ts.title: Local Identity Privacy Contracts
src/backend/__tests__/profile.test.ts.summary: Protects human attribution fallback, snake_case local profile persistence, sanitization back to human roles, BOM-tolerant reads, and preference for .git/info/exclude so private identity needs no shared repository change.

src/shared/lifecycle.test.ts.title: Lifecycle Date And Evidence Semantics
src/shared/lifecycle.test.ts.summary: Locks review-due and expiration boundaries, explicit-resolution precedence, local-calendar behavior, and refusal to infer event or release completion. Malformed marks must remain visible with evidence instead of being coerced or dropped.

src/cli/__tests__/context.test.ts.title: Agent Context Trust Rendering Contracts
src/cli/__tests__/context.test.ts.summary: Protects compact file and feature context: authority-sensitive warnings, relation drift, open-TODO selection, relation-closeness threshold filtering, lifecycle evidence, feature aggregates, and authority-ordered presentation.

src/cli/__tests__/compare.test.ts.title: File Trust Comparison Invariants
src/cli/__tests__/compare.test.ts.summary: Protects authority-first trust ordering while surfacing quality, review drift, warnings, TODO pressure, partial scores, normalized Windows paths, and lifecycle state. Lifecycle problems must not silently reorder authority precedence.

src/cli/__tests__/coverage.test.ts.title: Purposeful Coverage Accounting Contracts
src/cli/__tests__/coverage.test.ts.summary: Protects tracked-file discovery, ignore behavior, neutral repository inventory, authored file/directory scope counts, missing and wrong-kind partitions, selected-scope detail, unknown IDs, generated proposal non-promotion, provenance freshness, orphan detection, and annotation-depth ordering.

src/cli/__tests__/doctor.test.ts.title: Deterministic Maintenance Check Contracts
src/cli/__tests__/doctor.test.ts.summary: Protects clean reports, unsafe and missing paths, directory/untracked/deleted annotation handling, authored scope member kinds/roles/duplicates, supported directory subjects, malformed metadata, ID collisions, review drift, pending review, portable roots, bounded findings, and stable rendering.

src/backend/lib/__tests__/active-work.te.title: Active Work Persistence And Lease Contracts
src/backend/lib/__tests__/active-work.te.summary: Protects snake-case persistence, file/directory conflicts, shared overlap, expiry, path filtering, retained history, owner/session enforcement, TODO links, and TTL validation for the local coordination engine.

src/cli/__tests__/work.test.ts.title: Active Work CLI Workflow Contract
src/cli/__tests__/work.test.ts.summary: Runs the real CLI through claim, parent-path query, overlap rejection, TODO linkage, ignored-sidecar setup, release, and history inspection.

src/cli/__tests__/graph.test.ts.title: Semantic Fan-In And Fan-Out Traversal Contracts
src/cli/__tests__/graph.test.ts.summary: Protects reverse-index construction, normalized paths, bounded multi-hop traversal, closeness and relation filters, cycle and self-reference termination, prebuilt-index reuse, and directional text rendering.

src/mcp/__tests__/reads.test.ts.title: MCP Read-Builder Parity Contracts
src/mcp/__tests__/reads.test.ts.summary: Exercises reusable read builders against the demo catalogue across stats, lists, queries, context, comparisons, health, TODOs, tags, coverage, and doctor rendering. It does not cover MCP transport or tool registration.

src/mcp/__tests__/writes.test.ts.title: Agent Write Safety And Provenance Contracts
src/mcp/__tests__/writes.test.ts.summary: Protects dynamic agent attribution, locked-file rules, score-review invalidation, TODO and comment IDs, tag rename and deduplication, manifest audit entries, staged suggestions, and rejection of incomplete staged TODO metadata.

src/mcp/__tests__/integration.test.ts.title: Cross-Capability Metadata Workflow Contracts
src/mcp/__tests__/integration.test.ts.summary: Protects local workflows where writes immediately affect retrieval: findings become surprising, TODOs become queryable, annotations enter context, renamed tags update vocabulary, feature queries remain complete, and authored relations traverse correctly.

src/frontend/components/GraphView.test.t.title: Graph Navigation And Project Execution Regression Contracts
src/frontend/components/GraphView.test.t.summary: Protects pure focus, viewport, position, hover-label, duplicate-edge, weighted-ordering, project dependency direction, selected-task attachments, provenance-bearing structural edges, and local layout parsing. It does not exercise full browser canvas interaction or code-topology correctness.

src/frontend/components/TableView.test.t.title: Manifest Table Interpretation Contracts
src/frontend/components/TableView.test.t.summary: Protects helper logic that turns staged activity into compact previews, exposes freshness recommendations, and filters rows by recency. It does not exercise full table rendering or review interactions.

src/frontend/components/FileTree.test.ts.title: File-Tree Attention Heat Contracts
src/frontend/components/FileTree.test.ts.summary: Protects activity weighting and normalization helpers used by file-tree heat. It does not exercise tree interaction, path search, selection, or rendered navigation behavior.

src/frontend/lib/authority.test.ts.title: Authority Display Label Contracts
src/frontend/lib/authority.test.ts.summary: Pins compact and canonical authority labels plus conflict-precedence help text. It does not exercise score editing, persistence, or review attribution.

src/backend/__tests__/analytics.test.ts.title: Local Analytics Persistence And Scoring Contracts
src/backend/__tests__/analytics.test.ts.summary: Protects BOM-tolerant sidecar reads, per-file and daily counter semantics, search-hit behavior, and engagement weighting. It tests the analytics library, not route registration or HTTP behavior.

src/backend/__tests__/tree-walker.test.t.title: Filesystem Tree Discovery Contracts
src/backend/__tests__/tree-walker.test.t.summary: Protects filesystem discovery plus exclusion of ignored dependencies and the CanopyTag metadata directory. It tests the tree-walker library, not HTTP routing or file-tree UI interaction.

src/cli/__tests__/analytics-hook.test.ts.title: Analytics Hook Search-Heat Contracts
src/cli/__tests__/analytics-hook.test.ts.summary: Executes the hook in temporary repositories and protects Grep, Glob, and Bash ripgrep hit accounting plus BOM-tolerant metadata reads. It covers emitted analytics records, not installer merging, concurrency, or every PostToolUse event.

src/cli/__tests__/hook-install.test.ts.title: Analytics Hook Installer Contracts
src/cli/__tests__/hook-install.test.ts.summary: Runs the installer against temporary repositories and protects absolute command generation, in-place upgrade of legacy relative hooks without duplicates, and preservation of existing BOM-prefixed settings. It does not cover hook event recording.

tests/e2e/app-smoke.spec.ts.title: Welcome And Config Proxy Smoke Contracts
tests/e2e/app-smoke.spec.ts.summary: Checks welcome-screen entry actions and frontend proxy reachability for GET config. It does not exercise repository switching, directory browsing, or the backend's network-exposure boundary.

AGENTS.md.title: Contributor Operating Guide
AGENTS.md.summary: Stable operating contract for contributors: architecture, product boundaries, shared-versus-local data rules, agent workflow, trust semantics, and validation. Read it before changing CanopyTag or its dogfood metadata; fast-changing feature details belong in nearby docs.

README.md.title: Public-Facing Project Overview
README.md.summary: Public entry point for installation and the local CLI/MCP workflow. It presents authored catalogue discovery and post-rg enrichment as complementary, documents purposeful scope coverage and provider proposal separation, and preserves local-data, active-work, and loopback security boundaries.

docs/cli-cheatsheet.md.title: CLI Cheatsheet
docs/cli-cheatsheet.md.summary: Compact agent sequence: discover with authored search, confirm with rg, enrich and compare paths, inspect projects and purposeful scope coverage, coordinate active work, then review TODO, health, doctor, and analytics signals.

docs/repo-local-data.md.title: Repo-Local Data And Public Repo Hygiene
docs/repo-local-data.md.summary: Canonical boundary between authored shared metadata, optionally shared provenance-bearing generated proposals, and local-only identity, analytics, active-work, MCP, and hook state. It documents provider non-authority, same-checkout claims, portable roots, and the UTF-8/BOM read contract.

docs/roadmap.md.title: Public Roadmap
docs/roadmap.md.summary: Curated public roadmap covering prerelease status, implemented project UI and purposeful production-scope coverage, completed external-pattern comparison gates, agent navigation, analytics, graph views, structural overlays, and release boundaries.

docs/design/project-layer.md.title: Project Context And Control Plane
docs/design/project-layer.md.summary: Canonical project-layer design: documents implemented project API/UI parity, authored production-scope coverage, rich project tasks with typed dependencies/resources/receipts, milestones, computed readiness, local claims, directed visualization, and external-pattern adapter gates without surrendering authored truth.

docs/design/project-pattern-comparison.m.title: Project Pattern Comparison
docs/design/project-pattern-comparison.m.summary: Evidence-led RT-017 comparison of CanopyTag's representative project packet with agent-native dependency tracking, human PM, software-catalog, and JSON Canvas patterns. It classifies adopt/adapt/reject decisions and records export, privacy, API, backup, attribution, review, and undo gates for any future adapter.

docs/design/document-lifecycle-marks.md.title: Document Lifecycle Marks Proposal
docs/design/document-lifecycle-marks.md.summary: Design and staged implementation for lifecycle trust modifiers on file records. Preservation, strict validation, date-derived warnings, and context, compare, and health rendering work now; filters, reviewed writes, promotion, and UI editing remain proposed.

docs/design/canopy-cartographer-integrat.title: CanopyCartographer Integration Proposal
docs/design/canopy-cartographer-integrat.summary: Proposes a provenance-rich sidecar boundary: CanopyTag owns authored meaning and current lexical catalogue search; Cartographer may add generated structure and optional local semantic recall only with evidence, freshness signals, staged promotion, and benchmarked benefit.

docs/canopytag-vs-ripgrep.md.title: Positioning: When Metadata Beats Text Search
docs/canopytag-vs-ripgrep.md.summary: Explains complementary retrieval: bounded authored catalogue discovery helps when names are uncertain, while rg confirms symbols, text, and source truth. CanopyTag adds trust, TODO, and semantic context only where maintained annotations repay their cost.

docs/architecture-md-and-codeowners.md.title: Where CanopyTag Fits in the Metadata Ecosystem
docs/architecture-md-and-codeowners.md.summary: Positions CanopyTag beside ARCHITECTURE.md, AGENTS.md, ADRs, CODEOWNERS, and external wikis rather than as their replacement. The ecosystem comparison remains useful, but at least one illustrative command no longer matches the implemented CLI.

docs/design/agent-analytics.md.title: Agent Analytics Design And Privacy Contract
docs/design/agent-analytics.md.summary: Approved design and privacy contract for local-only agent activity heat across the hook, MCP-side increments, storage, CLI, and UI. The ignored sidecar is not MCP-exposed, is read-only through the loopback UI API, and hook installation writes a machine-specific absolute path that must remain uncommitted or be reviewed before sharing.

docs/surprise-and-traversal.md.title: Surprise-Based Navigation And Feature Traversal
docs/surprise-and-traversal.md.summary: Design note for routing across feature boundaries and recording expectation violations that filenames cannot convey. It prioritizes lightweight gotchas and drift signals, explicitly rejects a probabilistic surprise engine, and leaves several traversal questions open.

src/cli/analytics.ts.title: Local Analytics CLI
src/cli/analytics.ts.summary: Agent and human command for hot-file activity, navigation trends, and explicit analytics clearing or date pruning. It reads only the local sidecar and recalculates totals after pruning; its output is behavioral heat, not semantic relevance.

hooks/canopytag-analytics.mjs.title: Claude Code Local Analytics Hook
hooks/canopytag-analytics.mjs.summary: Optional Claude Code PostToolUse adapter that records local file touches and search-result heat without storing query strings. It must fail silently and never block agent work; concurrent writers may undercount because analytics are not an audit log.

src/cli/hook.ts.title: Claude Analytics Hook Installer
src/cli/hook.ts.summary: Installs or upgrades CanopyTag's PostToolUse analytics hook in .claude/settings.json without clobbering unrelated settings or duplicating entries. Generated commands use this checkout's absolute hook path, so output warns that local configuration needs review before public sharing.

src/cli/mcp.ts.title: Project-Local MCP Configuration Scaffolder
src/cli/mcp.ts.summary: Merges a CanopyTag server entry into an existing .mcp.json while preserving unrelated servers, refuses to replace a differing CanopyTag entry without force, and supports a print-only preview. Generated configuration contains local absolute paths.

src/cli/tags.ts.title: Tag Vocabulary CLI
src/cli/tags.ts.summary: Exposes live in-use tag counts, substring filtering, and soft declared-vocabulary health checks through the shared tag hygiene engine. Its search filters tags already present on cards; it is not fuzzy catalogue retrieval.

src/cli/shared.ts.title: CLI Shared Utilities — The Foundation Layer
src/cli/shared.ts.summary: Every CLI tool and MCP read tool imports from here. Provides resolveRepoRoot/resolveCanopyPath (canonical canopytag/canopy.json path), fileKind (extension+path→module/doc/test/config/asset/data), AUTHORITY_RANK for sorting, aggregateScore/warningCount for health checks, and the full filter+sort pipeline (FileFilters, parseBaseFilters, filterFiles, sortFiles). Defines 9 sort keys including 'attention' (composite: warnings + unreviewed + TODOs weighted by authority). Also handles git date integration for --git-after/--git-before filters.

src/cli/context.ts.title: canopytag context — Compact Agent Prompt Injection
src/cli/context.ts.summary: Renders compact context blocks for files, features, or projects. File output includes direct annotations plus implicated projects and inherited project TODOs without copying ownership; project mode shows the multi-file why, questions, and TODOs. Feature mode retains aggregate quality and TODO context.

src/cli/compare.ts.title: canopytag compare - File Trust Comparator
src/cli/compare.ts.summary: Compares exact files by authority rank, quality composite, freshness, warning count, TODO pressure, per-dimension scores, summaries, and trust order. This is the agent-facing tool for deciding which document or source file should win when multiple search hits conflict. Reuses shared authorityScore, aggregateScore, warningCount, and freshness helpers, and tracks explicit compared files as canopy queries.

src/cli/coverage.ts.title: canopytag coverage — Purposeful Scope Coverage
src/cli/coverage.ts.summary: Leads with named authored scope coverage, partitions file and directory targets into annotated, unannotated, missing, or wrong-kind states, and keeps whole-repository percentage informational. Optional generated scope candidates retain provider provenance and freshness and never affect authored counts. Tracked-file discovery, ignore filtering, orphans, and detail mode remain available.

todos.text: Add bounded, deterministic detailed coverage output that lists unannotated paths with stable sorting, explicit result limits, and structured output suitable for catalogue-completion queues.

src/cli/doctor.ts.title: canopytag doctor — Deterministic Maintenance Checks
src/cli/doctor.ts.summary: Consolidates objective CanopyTag maintenance evidence including authored scope shape, project task/milestone identity, dependency references and cycles, typed resources, safe owned/excluded paths, retained completion receipts, other malformed metadata, missing references, ID collisions, review drift, portable roots, and pending review. Its pure bounded inspection layer never invents or rewrites semantic metadata.

src/cli/graph.ts.title: Relation Graph Walker — Fan-in/Fan-out Engine
src/cli/graph.ts.summary: BFS graph traversal over relatedFiles edges. Builds a reverse index (who points at this file?) for fan-in, walks forward edges for fan-out. Returns a GraphNode tree with hop count, relation type, and closeness at each node. Configurable: hops (max depth), minCloseness (edge filter), relation (type filter). Renders as indented text with directional arrows (← fan-in, → fan-out). Used by canopytag_fan_in and canopytag_fan_out MCP tools. Pure computation — no I/O.

src/cli/init.ts.title: canopytag init — Repo Bootstrap
src/cli/init.ts.summary: Creates canopytag/ directory with empty canopy.json and default settings.json. Safe to run on already-initialized repos — detects existing canopytag/canopy.json and prints status without overwriting. Prints next-step guidance pointing to stats, ls, and MCP tools. Simple script — no guard needed since it's only invoked directly.

src/mcp/server.ts.title: MCP Server Entry Point
src/mcp/server.ts.summary: Small stdio entry point that creates McpServer and registers catalogue reads, canonical/review writes, and local active-work coordination through separate modules. Agents invoke it through project-local MCP config; business logic stays in the registered tool modules and shared libraries.

src/mcp/tools/agent-manifest.ts.title: Agent Manifest Review Report
src/mcp/tools/agent-manifest.ts.summary: Renders pending or historical agent-review entries with proposed fields, staged-versus-applied state, freshness suggestions, TODOs, rationale, and outcomes. File and status filters are exact, and output ordering is deterministic by date then ID.

src/mcp/tools/reads.ts.title: MCP Read Tools — Agent Query Interface
src/mcp/tools/reads.ts.summary: Registers 15 read-only MCP tools spanning orientation, computed project task readiness and execution packets, authored search, exact-file trust comparison, scoped TODOs, health, tag hygiene, activity review, relationship traversal, purposeful authored coverage, and deterministic doctor checks. Project reads derive local claimant context; coverage reads non-counting provider proposals.

comments.text: MCP read tools now include canopytag_compare for exact-file authority and quality comparison. It wraps src/cli/compare.ts and tracks matched files as canopy queries.

src/mcp/tools/active-work.ts.title: MCP Active Work Coordination Tools
src/mcp/tools/active-work.ts.summary: Registers agent-first tools to query, claim, renew, and release local expiring work. It shares the CLI claim engine, emits snake-case JSON, links TODOs without mutating them, reports conflicts explicitly, and keeps all coordination offline in the ignored target-repo sidecar.

src/mcp/__tests__/active-work.test.ts.title: MCP Active Work Surface Contract
src/mcp/__tests__/active-work.test.ts.summary: Pins the four bounded MCP coordination tool names so check-in, query, renewal, and check-out remain discoverable to agent harnesses.

src/mcp/tools/writes.ts.title: MCP Write Handlers — Mutation Logic
src/mcp/tools/writes.ts.summary: Mutation handlers for file metadata, project creation/update, file- or project-owned TODOs, tag renames, comments, and sidecar suggestions. Applied writes append attributed review activity with undo metadata; project scope never fabricates a representative file path.

src/mcp/tools/writes-registration.ts.title: MCP Write Tools — Zod Registration Layer
src/mcp/tools/writes-registration.ts.summary: Registers seven MCP write tools including project creation/update and exactly-one-scope file/project TODO writes. Zod schemas document replacement-array semantics and model attribution; handlers remain independently testable without MCP SDK dependencies.

src/mcp/tools/tags.ts.title: Tag Vocabulary Engine
src/mcp/tools/tags.ts.summary: Collects live tag vocabulary from canopy.json with usage counts. Supports search (substring match, alphabetical) and browse (top N by count). Includes fuzzy duplicate detection: Levenshtein distance <=2 and separator normalization (dash/underscore). buildTags() renders the full output with duplicate warnings. Used by canopytag_tags tool and by writes.ts to warn when new tags are near-duplicates of existing vocabulary.

src/backend/server.ts.title: Fastify Web Server — Bootstrap & Route Registration
src/backend/server.ts.summary: Web UI backend bootstrap: selects the repository, loads CanopyTag metadata, registers file, project, review, and supporting API routes, and runs the archive sweep. It binds to loopback by default; non-loopback exposure must be explicit and is unauthenticated.

src/backend/lib/network.ts.title: Backend Network Exposure Boundary
src/backend/lib/network.ts.summary: Resolves the backend bind host with a loopback-only default and emits a prominent warning for explicit non-loopback exposure. This is the safety boundary around CanopyTag's unauthenticated local repository API.

src/backend/__tests__/network.test.ts.title: Backend Network Boundary Tests
src/backend/__tests__/network.test.ts.summary: Verifies loopback-by-default host resolution, explicit override precedence, loopback recognition, and warnings for exposing the unauthenticated API.

src/backend/lib/analytics.ts.title: Agent Activity Analytics Engine
src/backend/lib/analytics.ts.summary: Local sidecar persistence and scoring for per-file reads, edits, writes, CanopyTag queries, and search hits with daily buckets. Atomic writes reduce sidecar corruption; counters remain approximate behavioral telemetry, not semantic authority or an audit log.

src/backend/lib/git-info.ts.title: Git Date Lookup
src/backend/lib/git-info.ts.summary: Two functions: getLastModified (git log -1 for a single file) and getLastModifiedBatch (iterates getLastModified for multiple files). Returns ISO date strings. Used by shared.ts for --git-after/--git-before filters and --modified sort key. Currently O(n) shell calls for batch — TODO notes optimization with git log --name-only.

src/backend/lib/tree-walker.ts.title: File System Tree Walker
src/backend/lib/tree-walker.ts.summary: Recursive directory walker that builds TreeNode structures for the sidebar file tree. Filters with ALWAYS_SKIP set (30+ entries: .git, node_modules, dist, IDE dirs, lock files, etc.), .gitignore patterns, and .ctagignore patterns. Folders sorted before files, then alphabetical. Used by the /api/tree endpoint. Separate from coverage's discoverRepoFiles which uses git ls-files instead of fs.readdir.

src/cli.summary: Serverless agent commands for orientation, filtering, context, comparison, TODOs, health, maintenance, coverage, graph walks, analytics, integration setup, and local expiring work claims. Most read commands share filtering and sorting primitives, and several surfaces are reused by MCP.

src/mcp.summary: Stdio MCP adapter for compatible agents. Read tools reuse CLI builders; write tools record attribution and undo data; local coordination tools expose expiring file or directory claims without requiring the web server.

src/backend/lib.summary: Backend helpers for canopy persistence, agent manifests, local profiles, analytics, expiring work claims, Git dates, merged records, filesystem trees, and network exposure. They support routes and CLI or MCP operations without owning UI policy.

src/backend/routes.summary: Fastify API surface for repository selection, tree and merged index reads, annotation mutations, settings, analytics, profiles, archives, and activity review. Routes share mutable per-repository state initialized by the server bootstrap.

src/frontend/components.summary: Human catalogue interface spanning explorer editing, sortable file and review tables, authored relationship graphs, local analytics, repo selection, settings, and agent-activity review. Large view components coordinate through the shared workspace store.

docs.summary: Public usage, positioning, operating boundaries, roadmap, and bounded design rationale. Stable guidance and exploratory blueprints coexist here, so authority, status, freshness, and lifecycle warnings must remain visible during retrieval.

src/shared.summary: Cross-surface contracts and deterministic transformations for schema, case conversion, lifecycle interpretation, and bounded authored catalogue search. These modules define behavior reused by CLI, MCP, backend, and UI without owning source topology.

production_candidate.name: CanopyTag production candidate
production_candidate.description: Release-facing entrypoints, core authored-context engines, human/agent access surfaces, and canonical operating guidance that should remain fully routable before a public release.

annotation-engine.name: Annotation Engine
annotation-engine.description: Authored metadata model and persistence boundary for summaries, trust, lifecycle, relationships, TODOs, comments, features, archives, and merged reads. Generated cartography should remain in provenance-rich sidecars rather than silently becoming canonical metadata.

cli-tools.name: Agent-Facing CLI
cli-tools.description: Local command surface for orientation, bounded authored catalogue search, comparison, health, maintenance, TODOs, coverage, analytics, MCP setup, hooks, and advisory active-work claims. Commands verify repo-local metadata without requiring the web server, and MCP reuses several engines.

web-ui.name: Web UI
web-ui.description: React and Fastify interface for browsing and editing annotations, tables, authored graphs, local analytics, activity review, profiles, and repository selection. Its unauthenticated local-repository backend must remain loopback-only unless exposure is explicit.

mcp-server.name: MCP Server
mcp-server.description: Local stdio adapter exposing catalogue reads, semantic relationship traversal, attributed mutations, staged suggestions, activity review, and expiring work coordination to compatible agents. It reuses shared engines instead of becoming a second intelligence store or orchestrator.

docs.name: Documentation And Positioning
docs.description: Public usage, contributor contracts, product positioning, lifecycle designs, and roadmap. README serves users, AGENTS governs contributors, and blueprint or draft design notes must not silently outrank current implementation.

lifecycle-trust.name: Lifecycle And Trust Signals
lifecycle-trust.description: Optional trust modifiers for temporary, provisional, superseded, condensation, and review-needed context. Read paths preserve and warn on authored marks without replacing authority, freshness, quality scores, or explicit human resolution.
open_questions: What reviewed write and promotion workflow should lifecycle marks use?
When should lifecycle filters and UI editing become default surfaces?

agent-analytics.name: Local Agent Analytics
agent-analytics.description: Optional local activity heat from client hooks and CanopyTag queries. It helps humans inspect navigation patterns without uploading source or storing query strings; behavioral frequency is not treated as semantic authority.
open_questions: Which analytics signals materially improve maintenance or retrieval decisions?
How should additional agent clients integrate without weakening privacy boundaries?

activity-review.name: Agent Activity Review
activity-review.description: Attributed review feed for direct agent writes and non-canonical suggestions. Humans can agree, fix, or reject entries with undo context, separating immediately useful agent work from later confidence and governance decisions.
open_questions: How should high-volume review remain fast without auto-promoting uncertain semantic changes?

PRJ-001.name: Project context and accountability control plane
PRJ-001.description: Evolve the implemented thin project umbrella into a usable human/agent context spine connecting objectives, tasks, dependencies, milestones, resources, tools, documentation, production scopes, attribution, actions, review, and evidence without becoming a monolithic scheduler or copying generated topology into authored truth.

milestones.name: Agent-readable execution packet
milestones.description: A project task can carry deterministic readiness, resources, safe edit scope, and retained completion evidence without changing file TODOs.

milestones.name: Directed human execution view
milestones.description: One bounded dependency/timeline view explains project ordering, resources, evidence, and saved layout without becoming a generic graph canvas.

milestones.name: External pattern comparison
milestones.description: One representative project is compared against bounded agent, PM, catalogue, and canvas references before adapter decisions.

todos.text: Dogfood the agent-facing project core before deciding whether a bounded project lane and detail panel earn UI space.

Implement project HTTP API and human UI parity before expanding the persisted schema: project lane/detail, file backlinks including unannotated linked files, inherited project tasks, bounded task presentation, safe mutation, and matching CLI/MCP/API/UI counts.

Design named authored scope sets such as production_candidate, alpha_critical, and supported_research; report meaningful coverage per scope, accept provenance-bearing generated membership proposals, and treat supported directory subjects separately from missing files.

Specify the smallest backward-compatible Task, dependency, milestone, ResourceRef, and ActionReceipt contract needed for fresh-agent handoffs, computed readiness, owned paths/exclusions, tools, documents, inputs/outputs, validation, attribution, and retained completion evidence.
todos.why_now: RT-013 made projects visible to humans and agents and RT-014 established purposeful production coverage; the next leverage point is making one project packet executable without reconstructing conversation history.

dependencies.reason: Purposeful coverage was intentionally completed before expanding the project execution schema.

resources.ref: A fresh-agent project packet with computed readiness and retained evidence

acceptance: Every existing Project.todos entry and every file Todo round-trips without migration.
depends_on and blocks edges produce deterministic readiness while parent_child and related remain non-blocking.
Live active-work path claims surface claimant context without entering canopy.json.
CLI, MCP, HTTP, and the Projects tab expose matching task readiness and execution context.
Doctor reports malformed task, milestone, dependency, resource, path, and receipt contracts including blocking cycles.
Build, focused tests, full tests, doctor, and production_candidate coverage pass with retained validation evidence.

receipts.summary: 401 tests across 49 files, the production build, diff check, 27/27 production scope coverage, doctor with zero errors, and an npm pack containing 127 entries with no QA artifacts all passed.
A real-browser Projects tab showed readiness counts, milestones, blockers, active claims, and expandable execution packets with zero console errors.
receipts.residual_risk: Task mutation remains read-only and directed dependency layout work remains RT-016.

residual_risks: Project task mutation remains read-only until a separately reviewed write contract is justified.
Directed dependency layout and visualization remain explicitly scoped to RT-016.

todos.text: Replace the one-force-graph assumption with one bounded prototype view: directed project/task dependency flow with readable cards, groups, labeled edges, saved human layout, resources/evidence, and provenance-bearing structural overlays kept visually distinct.
todos.why_now: The authored execution graph now has stable task, dependency, resource, milestone, and receipt semantics; one purposeful human view can be evaluated without inventing its data model at render time.

dependencies.reason: Visualization must consume the frozen execution contract instead of defining a second task truth.

resources.ref: One directed project/task dependency view with saved human layout

acceptance: The view answers one bounded project-ordering question with readable directed edges and cards.
Authored task/resource/evidence edges remain visually distinct from any provenance-bearing generated overlay.
Saved layout does not become a second source of project truth.
Task mutation and external-tool comparison remain outside this slice.

receipts.summary: Focused graph execution tests, the full 404-test suite across 49 files, and the production build passed; the graph projection preserves directed dependency semantics, selected-task attachments, local layout validation, and provenance-bearing structural-edge separation.

A real browser verified the Project graph at 1440px and 1024px: milestone swimlanes, directed readiness edges, selected-task resources, browser-local layout reset, and the explicit no-provider overlay state all rendered with zero console errors.
receipts.residual_risk: No provider-backed structural edge artifact exists yet, so the view intentionally renders an explicit empty overlay state.

residual_risks: Browser-local layout is deliberately a view-only convenience until a real shared or interoperable layout workflow is justified.
A future structural provider must supply visible provenance before its edges can be rendered.

todos.text: Run a bounded comparison of one representative project against agent-native dependency tracking, human PM, software-catalog, and canvas patterns; record what to adopt, adapt, or reject without installing a new authority into a downstream repo.
todos.why_now: Comparison is valuable only after CanopyTag has one native execution packet and one bounded human view to compare honestly against external patterns.

dependencies.reason: Compare a real native project view rather than a design aspiration.

resources.ref: A bounded adopt/adapt/reject comparison with export, privacy, API, backup, and attribution evidence

acceptance: One representative project is reproduced only far enough to compare the selected agent, PM, catalogue, and canvas patterns.
Every proposed adapter concept is classified adopt, adapt, or reject with evidence and product-boundary impact.
No external tool becomes authoritative or is installed into a downstream repository merely for the comparison.

receipts.summary: The documented comparison maps PRJ-001 to Beads, Plane, Backstage, and JSON Canvas patterns; it adopts the native packet and provenance boundaries, conditionally adapts a future one-way Canvas export, and rejects external authority or synchronization pending explicit gates.
receipts.residual_risk: The comparison is a desk evaluation of official materials, not a version-pinned export/import or self-hosted deployment trial.

residual_risks: No external adapter is justified until its version-pinned mapping, export/restore, privacy/API, attribution, review, and undo behavior are tested in a separately owned packet.
JSON Canvas remains only a future one-way view/export candidate; browser-local layout stays the current non-authoritative convenience.

open_questions: Do real shared-layout workflows justify a CanopyTag view record or interoperable JSON Canvas-style artifact beyond browser-local positions?
Which repeated, version-pinned workflow would justify a narrowly scoped one-way adapter after it proves mapping, privacy, restore, attribution, review, and undo behavior?
